title: Rig Relay Publication Preview Event v1
description: Append-only content-light canonical evidence event for a publication preview compilation. Envelope wraps a publication preview receipt plus operation-id for idempotency. Requires full governance-significant receipt fields via conditional constraints. Never stores raw file contents, private data, prompts, secrets, or deployment actions.

operation_id.description: Caller-supplied operation identity for exactly-once semantics. A retry of a prior request uses the same operation_id. A distinct user action uses a new operation_id.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the event was created

receipt.description: Publication preview evidence receipt. Must conform to rig.relay.publication_preview_receipt.v1 schema with full governance-completeness constraints.

receipt_id.description: Unique identifier for this receipt instance

compiled_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when compilation completed

compilation_successful.description: Whether compilation completed without safety or schema failures

profile_candidate_digest.description: SHA256 digest of the profile candidate used for compilation

result_digest.description: SHA256 digest of the compiler result. Required when compilation_successful is true.

refusal_code.description: PreviewRefusalCode value when compilation was refused. Required when compilation_successful is false.

refusal_reasons.description: Human-readable reasons for refusal. Required when compilation_successful is false.

deployment_ready.description: Whether output is ready for deployment. Always false when preview_only is true.

preview_only.description: Must always be true — this is strictly a preview boundary

evidence_digest.description: Deterministic SHA256 digest of the receipt itself

event_digest.description: Deterministic SHA256 digest of the event envelope (excluding event_digest field itself)
